create_stimulus_subclass: create a subclass of Stimulus that implements enable and disable methods for a custom stimulus
start_stimulus_with_timing: start a Stimulus instance with a delayed start time and specified duration using threading timers
end_stimulus_early: end a running Stimulus early by cancelling all timers and calling disable and teardown
add_trial_result_to_stimulus: add a trial result to the stimulus trial results dictionary with a name and value
create_end_timer_for_stimulus: create or replace an end timer on a Stimulus to schedule its termination at a specific time
